title: ANA InterContinental
description:
ANA InterContinental

ANA InterContinental is a leading hospitality group operating luxury hotels across Japan.

They welcome foreign SSW workers in housekeeping, food and beverage service, front desk,

and facility support roles. ANA InterContinental provides on-the-job training, language support,

and career development programs, helping international staff build a long-term career in Japan’s

hospitality industry.

industries.

title: Daikin Industries
description:
Daikin Industries

Daikin Industries is a global leader in air conditioning and refrigeration systems.

They hire SSW workers for roles such as equipment installation, maintenance technician,

and manufacturing support. Daikin offers skill-based training, safety certification

programs, and opportunities for career advancement—ideal for those pursuing the SSW

Construction or Manufacturing categories.

title: Kandenko
description:
Kandenko

Kandenko is a major engineering and construction company specializing in electrical,

communication, and energy systems. SSW workers can apply for positions as electricians,

site technicians, and project assistants. The company values teamwork, safety,

and professional growth, offering comprehensive training and technical skill development

for foreign staff working in Japan’s infrastructure field.

title: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries
description:
Mitsubishi Heavy Industries

Mitsubishi Heavy Industries is a global engineering and manufacturing leader.

They offer opportunities for SSW candidates in factory production, machinery

operation, and equipment assembly. MHI supports technical training, workplace

safety education, and skill development programs, making it a preferred employer

for skilled foreign workers in the SSW Manufacturing and Engineering sectors.

title: Nissan Motor Company
description:
Nissan Motor Company

Nissan Motor Company is a world-renowned automobile manufacturer based in Yokohama.

For SSW workers, Nissan offers opportunities in factory production, assembly, inspection,

and equipment maintenance. The company provides safe working environments, stable contracts,

and technical training, allowing foreign employees to gain valuable experience in Japan’s

title: Prince Hotels
description:
Prince Hotels

Prince Hotels & Resorts operates hotels, resorts, and leisure facilities throughout Japan.

They hire SSW candidates for guest relations, restaurant service, and facility maintenance.

The company offers accommodation assistance, uniform support, and Japanese language training,

making it one of the most welcoming employers for foreign workers starting their journey in

Japan’s hotel sector.

title: SOMPO Care
description:
SOMPO Care

SOMPO Care is one of Japan’s largest care service providers for the elderly.

They actively recruit caregivers and nursing support staff under the SSW

Caregiving category. SOMPO Care provides structured training programs, Japanese

language support, and certification assistance, ensuring foreign workers gain

the skills and knowledge to succeed in Japan’s growing healthcare industry.

title: Yoshinoya
description:
Yoshinoya

Yoshinoya is one of Japan’s most famous restaurant chains, known for its gyūdon (beef bowls).

They hire SSW candidates for kitchen, food preparation, and customer service positions.

Yoshinoya offers paid training, uniforms, and career growth support, making it a great choice

for workers under the SSW Food Service category.

title: Visa Guidance for Filipinos Applying for SSW 1 & 2
summary: Visa Guidance for Filipinos Applying for SSW 1 & 2
description:
Visa Guidance for Filipinos Applying for SSW 1 & 2

What is SSW?

The Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) visa allows foreign nationals

to work in Japan in designated industries. There are two types:

SSW 1: For those with skills in specific

sectors. Requires passing skills and Japanese language tests.

SSW 2: For advanced workers who have experience

under SSW 1 and meet additional requirements.

Eligibility for Filipinos

Must be a Filipino citizen residing in the Philippines.
